purpose: One-complex Boltz-2 pipeline and interpretation smoke test

protein.name: Human TYK2 JH1 kinase-domain crystallographic construct
protein.construct_notes: Exact deposited entity sequence, including N-terminal construct residues and a C-terminal hexahistidine tag; RCSB marks the entity as containing mutations. Structural scoring must use only residues present in the experimental coordinates.

ligand.name: TYK2 inhibitor 46
ligand.representation_notes: Neutral achiral representation matching RCSB CCD 0X5 and the OpenFF benchmark record. Protonation and tautomer sensitivity are not explored in exp001.

measurement.interpretation_note: Ki is retained as Ki. It must not be silently relabeled IC50 or Kd.

limitations: The 2013 structure may be represented directly or indirectly in model training data.
One complex cannot estimate correlation, ranking, calibration, or generalization.
The experimental endpoint is Ki whereas the Boltz continuous head is documented on an approximate log10(IC50/uM) scale.
The exact crystallographic construct contains noncanonical terminal construct residues and mutations.
